workstreams.name: Baseline, first two plants
workstreams.answers: Where does conversion cost per part sit in the first two plants diagnosed, and what drives it?
activities: Build the cost per part baseline from operational data
Observe lines and interview the people who run them
Trace conversion cost losses to their causes by line

workstreams.name: Baseline, third plant
workstreams.answers: Where does conversion cost per part sit in the third plant diagnosed, and what drives it?
activities: Apply the first-round method to the third plant
Observe the lines and interview the people who run them
Compare its loss causes with those of the first two plants

workstreams.name: Baseline, other three plants
workstreams.answers: Where does conversion cost per part sit in the other three plants, estimated from their data?
activities: Collect cost and production data for these plants
Extend the loss patterns found on the floor to their data
Test the estimates with the people who run each plant

workstreams.name: Cost improvement sizing
workstreams.answers: Which improvements, sized per plant, cut conversion cost per part by a measurable amount in every plant?
activities: List improvement options from loss causes with plant teams
Size the cost per part saving of each option by plant
Set out the go/no-go case and the pilot plant options

workstreams.name: Pilot plant improvements
workstreams.answers: Do the approved improvements show savings in the cost data at the pilot plant?
activities: Prepare the changes for go-live at the pilot plant
Launch the changes after the readiness workshop
Show the savings in cost data against the baseline

workstreams.name: Improvement rollout, wave 1
workstreams.answers: How are the improvements put in place in the first wave of plants?
activities: Adapt the piloted changes to each plant in the wave
Put the changes in place and train each plant's own teams
Track cost per part in each plant against its baseline

workstreams.name: Improvement rollout, wave 2
workstreams.answers: How are the improvements put in place in the remaining plants, so all six run them?
activities: Apply wave 1 lessons to the changes for each plant
Put the changes in place and train each plant's own teams
Track cost per part in each plant against its baseline

workstreams.name: Cost per part results
workstreams.answers: What conversion cost per part does each plant show against its baseline once the improvements run?
activities: Measure cost per part from plant data after wave 2
Compare each of the six plants with its baseline
Prepare the final readout with the COO and Plant Directors
